body:
North Carolina Retirement Systems (NCRS) has committed $300 million to HSRE NC Partners, a separate account with Harrison Street Asset Management.

This product invests in student and senior housing, as well as data centers. This allocation marks a continuation of the relationship between Harrison Street and NCRS, as the public pension fund committed $150 million to Harrison Street Real Estate Partners X in 2025.

NCRS had $150.5 billion in total assets under management as of Oct. 31.

p: North Carolina Retirement Systems(NCRS)가 Harrison Street Asset Management의 separately managed account인 HSRE NC Partners에 3억 달러를 투자하기로 약정했다.
이 상품은 학생 주택과 시니어 주택, 그리고 데이터센터에 투자한다. 이번 배정은 Harrison Street와 NCRS 간 관계가 이어지고 있음을 보여준다. 이 공적연금은 2025년에도 Harrison Street Real Estate Partners X에 1억 5천만 달러를 약정한 바 있다.
